cookies.descricao_pagina: The few cookies Ander Flow uses, what stays in your browser and how to erase everything.
cookies.intro: We use few cookies, all of them for the site to work. None of them is for tracking or advertising.

af_sessao.para_que: Identifies your session after you sign in; only the server reads it, never the page JavaScript

af_csrf.para_que: Protects forms and account actions against fake requests from other sites

idioma.para_que: Keeps whether the site should show up in Portuguese or English
idioma.duracao: Until you switch language or clear the cookies

tema.para_que: Keeps whether the site should show up in the light or dark theme
tema.duracao: Until you switch theme or clear the cookies

armazenamento.texto: Besides the cookies, some preferences and lists are kept in the browser local storage (localStorage) and never sent to the server:

terceiros.texto: We do not use tracking, advertising or third-party social network cookies.

gerenciar.texto: You can erase the cookies and the local storage in your own browser settings, at any time.
gerenciar.consequencia: If you erase everything, you are signed out (if you were signed in) and lose the language and theme preferences saved only on the device.
